Subject: Invoice sender authority & billing contact verification — delivery channel preference

Hi Claire —

Quick question on the BrightApp billing setup so we can finalize month-end delivery and AP automation. For invoicing we have three feasible delivery options:

1) Redwood-originated invoices: we generate the invoice PDF and either: email to ap@brightapp.com, push to your AP portal via API/webhook, or SFTP/e-invoice.
2) BrightApp-originated: BrightApp consumes line items via our billing export and generates a consolidated invoice on your side (rare, but some customers prefer).
3) Hybrid: Redwood issues invoices but you subscribe to a portal/webhook for machine ingestion and opt out of email PDF copies.

Can you confirm which you'd like? For option 1 we also need a short authorization to send invoices on our letterhead (many AP teams accept a DocuSign authorization rather than a signed PO amendment). If you prefer portal ingestion, please confirm the preferred mechanism: API webhook, SFTP drop, or a specific vendor portal (Coupa/Ariba/etc.).

Also, please confirm the billing contact for AP (name/email) and whether BrightApp requires VAT/EIN proof attached to every invoice or only upon request.

I've attached the PO you forwarded (BrightApp_PO_4789.pdf) so we can match line items. If you'd like to jump on a quick 15‑minute call to walk through the portals, happy to set it up.

Thanks —
